name: GPTrends Agent Analytics
author: GPTrends

sections.description:
Agent Analytics from GPTrends helps you understand how AI agents and bots crawl, ingest, and interact your website content in real-time. Turn AI visibility optimization from a black box into data-driven action.

Features

  • Real-time monitoring: Monitor real-time visits to your website by AI bots & agents from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and more.
  • Identify tech blockers: Identify where bots and agents getting stuck when trying to learn about your brand and products.
  • Find trending topics: Optimize your content strategy based on what AI agents and real ChatGPT users are looking for.
  • No plan required: All you need is a free GPTrends account, no credit card required.
  • Simple set up: Just create an account, generate a Website ID and start tracking.
  • Lightweight & privacy-focused: No impact on your site’s performance. Non-blocking, async tracking that respects user privacy.
  • No frontend code: Zero JavaScript loaded on your site.

Why Track AI Agents?

AI platforms are increasingly important traffic sources for organic growth, however content ingestion by AI platforms differs signficantly from Google search:

  • AI bots & agents regularly visit websites to collect, update, and verify information not only for the training of LLMs, but also to power real-time AI search and live answers.
  • This crawling behavior determines which content is available and ingested into AI chat assistants and how your brand and products are represented in AI-generated responses.
  • Importantly, AI bots behave differently than the Google web crawler. Most do not run JavaScript or maintain cookies or session state. If your site is JS heavy or not server-side rendered then there’s a risk that your content is not being ingested correctly.

Understanding which AI agents, bots & crawlers visit your site helps you:

  • Identify technical blockers e.g. Javascript heavy pages limiting the ingestion of your content into AI models and apps.
  • Discover what topics real ChatGPT users are prompting for in real time via “User Initiated” agents.
  • Understand the whole AI discovery journey: from bot content ingestion to human visits and conversions.

How It Works

  1. Sign up for a free GPTrends account
  2. Generate a unique Website ID
  3. Enter the Website ID in the plugin settings
  4. Enable tracking and you’re done!

External Services

This plugin sends pageview data to the GPTrends API to track AI agent and bot visits to your website.

Service: GPTrends API (https://api.gptrends.io)

Data sent: Page URL, user agent, referrer, IP address, and your Website ID

When: On each pageview when tracking is enabled (excludes admin pages and static files)

Privacy Policy: https://gptrends.io/privacy

Terms of Service: https://gptrends.io/terms

Support

Need help? Visit our documentation or reach out to team@gptrends.io.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “GPTrends Agent Analytics”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to Settings > GPTrends in your WordPress admin
  2. Check “Enable Tracking”
  3. Enter your Website ID from gptrends.io
  4. Click “Save Changes”
sections.faq:
Do I need a GPTrends account?

Yes, you need a free account with GPTrends to generate a Website ID and view analytics.

Does this affect my site’s performance?

No. The plugin uses non-blocking async requests that don’t impact page load times.

What AI platforms do you track?

We track all major AI platforms including ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Mode / AI Overviews and many others.

Is this GDPR compliant?

Yes. The plugin tracks bot behavior, not personal user data. It’s designed with privacy in mind.

Does this work with caching plugins?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with all major caching plugins.

Can I use this with other analytics plugins?

Absolutely! GPTrends works alongside Google Analytics, Matomo, and other analytics tools.
